sheet_notes.Tileset_1_MV.png: Street/parking ground sheet; right side has round street tree, tall conifer, cypress row, tree-in-planter base, bushes, planters, dumpsters, lamp posts.
sheet_notes.Tileset_17_MV.png: Park/playground: grass-dirt patches, big round oak (bare and in planter), logs, potted trees, flower patches and flower-hedge planters, window boxes; basketball hoops, sandboxes, seesaws, lemonade stand (not nature).
sheet_notes.Tileset_20_MV.png: Treehouse oak (complete) plus cabin/ladder/platform modules, a spreading oak and an oak with tire swing.
sheet_notes.Tileset_21_MV.png: Forest-wall modules: dense tree canopy rows with grey railing at the bottom (oak, conifer, round-tree variants) that tile horizontally into an impassable border.
sheet_notes.Tileset_25_MV.png: Pond/water autotile pieces (grass/water banks, deep water patches), lily pads, beach balls, floating apples, apple trees with alternate trunk rows, small fruit trees, baskets and fruit piles.
sheet_notes.Tileset_26_MV.png: Tree sheet. Each tree = canopy + brown-trunk bottom row; the row(s) directly below are alternate bottoms (pale sycamore-like bark, then grey bark) that replace the trunk row. Strip wraps: 8,0 and 13,0 are grey-bark bottoms for the trees at 0,11 and 5,11.
sheet_notes.Tileset_27_MV.png: Continuation of the tree strip: huge oak, dead trees, tall spruce, tall-canopy tree, tall-trunk apple, each with alternate bark rows below. Rows 0-3 cols 8-13 and rows 4-7 cols 8-13 are partial canopy/trunk extension pieces (not complete trees); rows 14-15 cols 0-5 are cut-off conifer tops.
sheet_notes.Tileset_28_MV.png: Wooden dock/pier kit over water (decks, pier with boat slip, edge posts, broken planks, pilings), fishing rods, fish, lifebuoys, crates, barrels.
sheet_notes.Tileset_69_MV.png: Hedge kit: hedge walls/maze pieces, iron gate in hedge, hedge arches, potted and free topiaries, round/wide/flowering bushes, animal topiaries.
sheet_notes.Tileset_70_MV.png: Park statuary: animal topiaries, small garden statues and urns, wall basins, tiered fountains (grey and sandstone, with water and dry), large angel statue, maiden-with-urn fountain.
sheet_notes.Tileset_78_MV.png: Water-side dressing: reeds/cattails, lily pads, rocks in water, pilings, carved face posts, no-swimming signs, bollards with rope, tall reeds, ladders, stumps/posts; bottom rows cut off.
sheet_notes.Tileset_81_MV.png: Small nature dressing (rocks, ferns, mushrooms, flower patches, flower boxes, pots, canopy shadow decals) plus cemetery set: headstones, stone crosses, coffins, open grave.
